/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("cPickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("_pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization of data using pickle, yaml, or marshal.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection from Environment
 * @description Command injection from environment variables
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-env
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CommandInjectionEnvConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getAValueReachableFromSource() or
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution ce).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionEnvFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionEnvConfig>;
import CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionEnvFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionEnvFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "environment variable"

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Assert used for security
 * @description Use of assert for security checks can be bypassed.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/assert-used-for-security
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-617
 */

import python
import semmle.python.Concepts

from Assert a, ControlFlowNode c
where
    a.getTest() = c.getNode()
    and
    // Heuristic: check if the assert condition involves security-relevant keywords
    (
        c.getNode().(Name).getId().matches("%auth%") or
        c.getNode().(Name).getId().matches("%perm%") or
        c.getNode().(Name).getId().matches("%admin%") or
        c.getNode().(Name).getId().matches("%access%") or
        c.getNode().(Name).getId().matches("%token%")
    )
select a, "Assert statement potentially used for security check."
findings.hypothesis: Assert statements used for security logic which can be optimized out.
